name: Birdfolk Dockmaster
notes: Complete NPC stat block from Humblewood Campaign Setting v1.04.

statBlock.name: Birdfolk Dockmaster
statBlock.otherStatistics: Leather armor. Athletics +2, Perception +5, Persuasion +4. Passive Perception 15. Birdfolk. Understands Auran without speaking it.
statBlock.description: Keeps the crews and cargo moving at Saltar’s Port.

sections.Traits:
Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., use a reaction to fly up to the creature’s speed in one direction while descending. Land in an empty space at the end of the move and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields prevent gliding, but the creature may drop held items as part of the reaction.
Confidence. Add the dockmaster’s Charisma modifier to initiative.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage if made with advantage. It also qualifies if an ally of the dockmaster within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated, and the attack has no disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Saber attacks and one Dagger attack.
Saber. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

ruleNotes: The Dagger line calls it a melee attack and lists a thrown range of 20/60 ft. Treat that range as its thrown range.

name: Cervan Bandit General
notes: Complete NPC stat block from Humblewood Campaign Setting v1.04.

statBlock.name: Cervan Bandit General
statBlock.otherStatistics: Studded leather armor. Saving throws Dex +5, Cha +4. Deception +4, Persuasion +4. Passive Perception 10. Birdfolk and Cervan.
statBlock.description: A bandit leader who keeps rival crews in line and fights with a blade in each hand.

sections.Traits:
Surge of Vigor (recharges after a long rest). When one attack deals more than half its current HP in damage, the general immediately regains 8 (1d12 + 2) HP, even if the hit drops it to 0.
Standing Leap. Long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks and one melee Dagger attack, or make two ranged Dagger attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 to AC against one melee attack that would hit. The general must see the attacker and hold a melee weapon.
sections.Encounter notes: For Benna Seridan, use a Blade of the Wood scimitar in her main hand (+1 to attack and damage rolls) and a shortsword in her off hand (1d6 + 3 piercing damage).

Antlers. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) when wielded with two hands.
sections.Spellcasting:
3rd-level Wisdom spellcaster. Save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Light, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Bless, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (2 slots). Calm Emotions, Warding Bond.
